jobs.title: U.S. Citizen only - Power BI, Data Analyst, and Cost Modeling
jobs.description:
You must be a U.S. Citizen.

Apex Consulting Solutions
is in search of a Data Analytics, Power BI, Cost Modeling, and Power Platform Analyst who will be responsible for developing data-driven financial models and providing insights into cost structures, budgeting, and forecasting. This role involves leveraging Power BI to visualize and interpret data to support decision-making processes and optimize financial performance. The analyst will work closely with cross-functional teams, including finance, operations, and senior management, to present cost analysis and projections that align with business goals. The analyst will leverage Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate to develop and maintain financial models, interactive dashboards, and automated workflows. This role blends technical skills in Power BI with financial expertise in cost modeling, making it ideal for candidates skilled in data visualization, financial analysis, and strategic budgeting.

Key Responsibilities:

·       Data Analysis & Visualization:
Design and build interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI to provide clear visibility into cost performance, budget trends, and financial metrics.
·       Cost Modeling:
Develop, maintain, and improve cost models to predict expenses, forecast budgets, and identify cost-saving opportunities.
·       Financial Reporting:
Create financial reports and analyses for management, detailing cost behaviors, variance analysis, and cost structures.
·       Data Integration:
Gather, cleanse, and integrate data from multiple sources, including ERP systems, financial databases, and other relevant systems.
·       Performance Forecasting:
Support financial forecasting by analyzing historical trends, current performance data, and potential future scenarios.
·       Automation & App Development:
Use Power Automate to design and implement automated workflows, ensuring streamlined data integration, data validation, and notification systems for cost tracking and reporting. Develop custom applications in Power Apps to simplify data entry, cost tracking, and budgeting processes for team members and stakeholders.
·       Stakeholder Communication:
Present cost analysis, forecasts, and findings to senior management and other stakeholders, translating complex data into actionable insights.
·       Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to enhance data collection processes, reporting, and financial modeling capabilities.

Requirements:

·       Clearance Requirement:
Must have an Active Secret Clearance or be able to obtain a minimum secret clearance, must be a U.S. Citizen.

·       Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Finance, Economics, Data Science, Accounting, or related field. Master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., CFA, CPA) is a plus.
·       Experience:
1-3 years of experience in cost analysis, financial modeling, or data analysis roles. Recent graduates welcome to apply
·       Technical Skills:

o   Proficiency in Power BI, including DAX and Power Query for data transformation.
o   Strong knowledge of financial modeling and cost management principles.
o   Advanced Excel skills, particularly in complex financial formulas, pivot tables, and VBA
·       Analytical Skills:
Ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and deliver insights with a focus on cost optimization.
·       Soft Skills:
Strong communication skills to present financial information clearly to non-financial audiences. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
·       Candidates MUST be available to work onsite in Washington, D.C. 2-3 days a week supporting Federal Government agency client.

Preferred Qualifications:

·       Experience with SQL or other database management tools.
·       Familiarity with ERP systems, such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics.
·       Background in business intelligence and data analytics.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

University Health is a health system committed to supporting the delivery of quality, coordinated care. Accurate and accessible medical records are essential to that work, helping care teams, patients, and organizational partners rely on complete documentation. The medical records function supports the integrity of patient information while working with clinics, providers, internal departments, university partners, and vendors. Team members contribute to processes that protect confidential information, meet regulatory requirements, and promote a positive experience for patients and colleagues.

About The Role

University Health is seeking a detail-oriented medical records professional to support record integrity, documentation quality, and efficient records operations. In this role, you will help identify and resolve duplicate medical records, coordinate requests involving amendments and corrections, and locate appropriate documentation in electronic medical record (EMR) systems. You will also assist with audits, quality compliance reviews, and statistical analysis, while ensuring records and data are distributed appropriately.

This position combines administrative coordination, quality assurance, and communication. You will work with management to advance departmental goals and contribute to improvements in processes, procedures, equipment, and staffing needs. The role may also involve coordinating the activities of assigned staff and vendors, supporting training, and engaging providers and clinics to address documentation deficiencies. Success requires discretion, sound judgment, accuracy, and a service-oriented approach.

Qualifications

An associate degree is required. Candidates must also have at least two years of experience in administrative and clerical duties. Knowledge of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) is preferred, as is HIPAA certification. Applicants should be comfortable working with databases and electronic records, reviewing documentation carefully, and communicating with a range of internal and external contacts. The ability to organize requests, follow established policies, protect confidential information, and manage multiple priorities is important. Candidates should also be prepared to support staff training and work collaboratively toward department objectives.

Responsibilities

Support the identification, review, and merging of duplicate medical records, following applicable procedures to maintain accurate patient information. Coordinate findings and requests related to medical record amendments and corrections, and work with University partners and vendors to resolve identification discrepancies and make appropriate chart corrections. Use medical records database systems to identify relevant documentation in EMR formats and distribute records or data as authorized.

Assist with medical record audits, statistical analysis, and quality compliance reviews. Monitor documentation deficiencies in accordance with organizational policy and applicable state and federal requirements. Coordinate quality assurance activities associated with work performed by assigned staff and vendors, and communicate concerns or patterns to management. Initiate provider and clinic engagement, offering training or guidance as needed to support complete and consistent documentation.

Contribute to the development and delivery of training for internal and external departmental staff. Work with management to implement projects and activities that support short- and long-term departmental goals. Identify opportunities to improve work processes, procedures, equipment, and personnel needs. Carry out responsibilities in accordance with applicable federal and state regulations and accrediting standards, including HIPAA and Joint Commission requirements. Promote University Health’s Guest Relations Policy through respectful, responsive service.

Benefits

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the accuracy and quality of medical records in a healthcare setting and to collaborate with a broad network of departments and partners. Employees may have access to University Health benefit programs and professional development resources, subject to eligibility, plan terms, and organizational policies. Candidates can confirm current benefit details during the hiring process.

Equal Opportunity

University Health is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable laws and without discrimination based on any status protected by law. Applicants who need an accommodation during the application or hiring process are encouraged to contact University Health to request assistance.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst — AI Model Reviewer (Python & GitHub)
jobs.description:
Financial Analyst — AI Model Reviewer

About The Role

What if your deep knowledge of financial modeling could directly shape how AI performs the work of a professional analyst? We're looking for Finance Subject Matter Experts who also know their way around Python and GitHub to audit, refine, and improve AI-generated financial modeling tasks — making sure they mirror how real analysts actually work.

You'll review AI task instructions and scoring rubrics, then roll up your sleeves and edit Markdown files and Python scripts directly via Pull Requests to fix logic errors, close clarity gaps, and ensure every task meets professional standards. If you can build a DCF in your sleep and know your way around a P&L, this role was made for you.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Candidates must have strong US-based financial knowledge and fluency with American financial terminology and conventions.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Compensation: $80–$110/hour
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Audit AI-generated financial modeling tasks to ensure they accurately replicate professional analyst workflows
Validate task instructions and scoring rubrics for logical soundness, completeness, and real-world relevance
Directly edit Markdown files and Python scripts via Pull Requests to resolve logic errors, ambiguity, or clarity gaps
Evaluate whether AI outputs reflect correct application of concepts like DCF analysis, P&L interpretation, financial statement modeling, and valuation techniques
Provide clear, structured feedback grounded in professional financial expertise
Collaborate asynchronously with a distributed team using GitHub-based workflows
Work independently on task-based assignments at your own pace and schedule

Who You Are

Deep subject matter expertise in finance — you've worked as an analyst, in investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, FP&A, or a closely related field
Strong command of US-based financial terminology and frameworks (DCF, P&L, balance sheet analysis, WACC, comparable company analysis, etc.)
Proficient in Python — comfortable reading, writing, and debugging scripts used for financial calculations
Experienced with GitHub — you can clone repos, create branches, and submit Pull Requests without hand-holding
Comfortable editing Markdown for technical documentation
Detail-oriented with a systematic, quality-driven approach to review work
Clear, precise written communicator who can articulate what's wrong and why
Self-motivated and reliable when working independently

Nice to Have

CFA, CPA, or MBA with a finance concentration
Professional experience building financial models in Excel or Python for deal evaluation, forecasting, or valuation
Background in teaching, mentoring, or creating training materials for financial concepts
Familiarity with AI/ML evaluation workflows or data annotation projects
Experience writing or reviewing technical rubrics or assessment criteria

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact task-based work
Apply your hard-earned financial expertise to a genuinely novel problem — teaching AI to think like a real analyst
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
